--host.tooltip:
Host IP Address
• Function: IP address for server to bind and listen for connections
• Range: Valid IPv4/IPv6 addresses or UNIX socket paths ending in .sock
• Server Default: 127.0.0.1 (local only)
• Effects: 127.0.0.1=local access only, 0.0.0.0=all network interfaces, specific IP=that interface only

--port.tooltip:
Server Port
• Function: TCP port number for server to listen for incoming connections
• Range: 1 to 65535 (1024+ recommended for non-root)
• Server Default: 8080
• Effects: <1024=requires root privileges, 8080-8090=common dev ports, >1024=user accessible

--timeout.tooltip:
Server Timeout
• Function: Maximum time in seconds for server read/write operations before timing out
• Range: 1 to unlimited (10-3600 recommended)
• Server Default: 600 (10 minutes)
• Effects: Too low=premature timeouts, too high=hung connections, 300-1200=typical range

--threads-http.tooltip:
HTTP Processing Threads
• Function: Number of threads dedicated to processing HTTP requests (separate from inference threads)
• Range: -1 or 1 to 128 (-1 = auto-detection)
• Server Default: -1 (auto-detect)
• Effects: -1=optimal auto-detection, 1-4=light load, 8-16=heavy load, 32+=very high concurrency

--model.tooltip:
Model File Path
• Function: Path to GGUF model file that the server will load and run
• Range: Valid path to .gguf file
• Server Default: models/7B/ggml-model-f16.gguf (if no HF options set)
• Effects: Required parameter - server cannot start without valid model file

--n-gpu-layers.tooltip:
GPU Layer Offload
• Function: Number of transformer layers to store in GPU VRAM instead of system RAM
• Range: 0 to model layer count (typically 32-80+ layers)
• Server Default: 0 (CPU-only)
• Effects: 0=CPU only, 33=half GPU, 99=attempt full GPU, higher numbers=more GPU utilization

--split-mode.tooltip:
Multi-GPU Split Strategy
• Function: Method for distributing model across multiple GPUs
• Range: none, layer, row
• Server Default: layer
• Effects: none=single GPU, layer=split layers+KV across GPUs, row=tensor parallelism across GPUs

--main-gpu.tooltip:
Primary GPU Index
• Function: GPU device index for model or intermediate results (usage depends on split-mode)
• Range: 0 to available GPU count - 1
• Server Default: 0 (first GPU)
• Effects: With none=main model GPU, with row=intermediate results GPU, 0=first GPU, 1=second GPU, etc.

--ctx-size.tooltip:
Context Window Size
• Function: Maximum number of tokens the model can consider at once (prompt + previous conversation)
• Range: 512 to 131072+ (0 = use model's default)
• Server Default: 4096
• Effects: Larger=longer conversations but more VRAM/RAM usage, 4096=standard, 8192=extended, 32768+=very long context

--batch-size.tooltip:
Logical Batch Size
• Function: Maximum number of tokens processed together in batched operations
• Range: 1 to 16384+
• Server Default: 2048
• Effects: Higher=better throughput but more VRAM, 512=conservative, 2048=balanced, 4096+=high throughput

--ubatch-size.tooltip:
Physical Batch Size
• Function: Actual number of tokens processed simultaneously by GPU hardware
• Range: 1 to 4096+ (should be ≤ batch-size)
• Server Default: 512
• Effects: Must be ≤ logical batch size, higher=better GPU utilization, 256=conservative, 512=balanced

--cache-type-k.tooltip:
Key Cache Quantization
• Function: Data type for storing attention key vectors in KV cache
• Range: f32, f16, bf16, q8_0, q4_0, q4_1, iq4_nl, q5_0, q5_1
• Server Default: f16
• Effects: f16=best quality+standard VRAM, q8_0=half VRAM+good quality, q4_0=quarter VRAM+lower quality

--cache-type-v.tooltip:
Value Cache Quantization
• Function: Data type for storing attention value vectors in KV cache
• Range: f32, f16, bf16, q8_0, q4_0, q4_1, iq4_nl, q5_0, q5_1
• Server Default: f16
• Effects: Usually matches cache-type-k, f16=quality+standard VRAM, q8_0=half VRAM, q4_0=quarter VRAM

--flash-attn.tooltip:
Flash Attention
• Function: Memory-efficient attention algorithm that reduces VRAM usage and improves speed
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (disabled)
• Effects: true=major speed boost+lower VRAM, false=standard attention, requires compatible GPU architecture

--threads.ui_widget: Number spinner with CPU core detection
--threads.tooltip:
CPU Generation Threads
• Function: Number of CPU threads used for text generation processing
• Range: -1 or 1 to 128 (-1 = auto-detection)
• Server Default: -1 (auto-detect)
• Effects: -1=optimal auto-detection, manual count=specific threading, more threads=better CPU utilization up to core count

--temp.tooltip:
Temperature
• Function: Controls randomness in token selection by scaling logit probabilities
• Range: 0.0 to infinity (practical limit: ~2.0)
• Server Default: 0.8
• Effects: 0.0=deterministic, 0.1-0.3=focused, 0.8=balanced, 1.2+=creative

--top-k.tooltip:
Top-K Sampling
• Function: Limits token selection to the K most probable tokens, filtering out low-probability options
• Range: 0 to 1000+ (0 = disabled, uses all tokens)
• Server Default: 40
• Effects: 0=no filtering, 1-10=very focused, 20-50=balanced, 100+=more diverse, high values approach no limit

--top-p.tooltip:
Top-P (Nucleus) Sampling
• Function: Selects from smallest set of tokens whose cumulative probability ≥ P
• Range: 0.0 to 1.0 (1.0 = disabled, uses all tokens)
• Server Default: 0.9
• Effects: 0.1=very focused, 0.5=moderate filtering, 0.9=balanced, 1.0=no filtering

--min-p.tooltip:
Min-P Sampling
• Function: Sets minimum probability threshold relative to most likely token (adaptive threshold)
• Range: 0.0 to 1.0 (0.0 = disabled)
• Server Default: 0.1
• Effects: 0.0=disabled, 0.02=very permissive, 0.05=balanced, 0.1=focused, 0.2+=very restrictive

--typical.tooltip:
Locally Typical Sampling
• Function: Filters tokens based on information content relative to expected entropy
• Range: 0.0 to 1.0 (1.0 = disabled)
• Server Default: 1.0 (disabled)
• Effects: 0.9-0.95=typical content, 0.8=more focused, 1.0=disabled, lower values=more predictable

--top-n-sigma.tooltip: Default top-n-sigma sampling for all requests (appears as 'top_n_sigma' in /slots endpoint). Statistical threshold-based token filtering on pre-softmax logits. -1.0=disabled. WARNING: This parameter may not work in your llama.cpp version (5685). Upgrade to a newer build for CLI support. Server default: -1.0. API requests can override this value.

--mirostat.tooltip:
Mirostat Mode
• Function: Perplexity-based adaptive sampling that maintains target entropy
• Range: 0, 1, 2 (0 = disabled, 1 = Mirostat v1, 2 = Mirostat v2)
• Server Default: 0 (disabled)
• Effects: 0=standard sampling, 1=v1 algorithm, 2=v2 (improved), overrides top-k/top-p when enabled
• WARNING: Top K, Nucleus and Locally Typical samplers are ignored if used

--seed.tooltip:
Random Number Generator Seed
• Function: Controls random number generation for reproducible results
• Range: -1, 0 to 4,294,967,295 (-1 = random seed each time)
• Server Default: -1 (random)
• Effects: -1=different each time, fixed number=identical results, essential for deterministic testing

--ignore-eos.tooltip:
Ignore End-of-Stream Token
• Function: Controls whether generation stops at EOS token or continues indefinitely
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (respect EOS)
• Effects: false=normal stopping, true=continues past natural end
• WARNING: Implies --logit-bias EOS-inf (automatically bans EOS token)

--repeat-penalty.tooltip:
Repeat Penalty
• Function: Penalizes repeat sequences of tokens to reduce repetitive patterns
• Range: 0.0 to 2.0+ (1.0 = no penalty)
• Server Default: 1.0 (disabled)
• Effects: 1.0=no penalty, 1.05-1.1=subtle, 1.1-1.2=moderate, 1.3+=strong anti-repetition

--repeat-last-n.tooltip:
Repeat Last N
• Function: Number of recent tokens to consider when applying repetition penalty
• Range: -1, 0 to context_size (-1 = use full context, 0 = disabled)
• Server Default: 64
• Effects: 0=no memory, 32=short memory, 64=balanced, 128+=long memory, -1=full context

--presence-penalty.tooltip:
Presence Penalty
• Function: Flat penalty for any token that has appeared previously (binary presence check)
• Range: -2.0 to 2.0 (0.0 = no penalty)
• Server Default: 0.0 (disabled)
• Effects: 0.0=disabled, 0.1=subtle diversity, 0.5=moderate, 1.0+=strong vocabulary expansion

--frequency-penalty.tooltip:
Frequency Penalty
• Function: Proportional penalty based on how often tokens have appeared (frequency-weighted)
• Range: -2.0 to 2.0 (0.0 = no penalty)
• Server Default: 0.0 (disabled)
• Effects: 0.0=disabled, 0.1=gentle reduction, 0.5=moderate, 1.0+=strong frequency balancing

--dry-multiplier.tooltip:
DRY Multiplier
• Function: Penalty multiplier for repeated n-gram sequences (Don't Repeat Yourself sampling)
• Range: 0.0 to 5.0+ (0.0 = disabled)
• Server Default: 0.0 (disabled)
• Effects: 0.0=disabled, 0.8=subtle, 1.0=moderate, 2.0=strong, 3.0+=very aggressive anti-repetition

--dry-base.tooltip:
DRY Base
• Function: Base penalty value used in DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) sequence detection algorithm
• Range: 1.0 to 4.0
• Server Default: 1.75
• Effects: 1.0=minimal penalty, 1.75=balanced, 2.5=moderate, 4.0=strong penalty scaling

--dry-allowed-length.tooltip:
DRY Allowed Length
• Function: Minimum n-gram sequence length before DRY penalty is applied
• Range: 0 to 10
• Server Default: 2
• Effects: 1=single tokens, 2=pairs, 3=triplets, 4+=longer sequences, higher=less aggressive

--dry-penalty-last-n.tooltip:
DRY Penalty Last N
• Function: Number of recent tokens to scan for repeated sequences in DRY sampling
• Range: -1, 0 to 1000+ (-1 = use full context, 0 = disabled)
• Server Default: -1 (full context)
• Effects: 0=disabled, 64=short memory, 256=moderate, -1=full context scan

--xtc-probability.tooltip:
XTC Probability
• Function: Exclude Top Choices sampling - probability of excluding the most likely token
• Range: 0.0 to 1.0 (0.0 = disabled)
• Server Default: 0.0 (disabled)
• Effects: 0.0=disabled, 0.1=occasional exclusion, 0.3=moderate diversity, 0.5+=high unpredictability

--xtc-threshold.tooltip:
XTC Threshold
• Function: Minimum probability threshold for XTC exclusion to activate
• Range: 0.0 to 1.0
• Server Default: 0.1
• Effects: 0.1=exclude when top token >10%, 0.5=only when >50%, 1.0=never exclude, lower=more aggressive

--dynatemp-range.tooltip:
Dynamic Temperature Range
• Function: Allows temperature to vary based on entropy - creates range [temp-range, temp+range]
• Range: 0.0 to 2.0 (0.0 = disabled, fixed temperature)
• Server Default: 0.0 (disabled)
• Effects: 0.0=fixed temp, 0.1=subtle variation, 0.3=moderate adaptation, 0.5+=high dynamics

--dynatemp-exp.tooltip:
Dynamic Temperature Exponent
• Function: Controls the curve/shape of how dynamic temperature varies with entropy
• Range: 0.1 to 5.0
• Server Default: 1.0 (linear)
• Effects: 0.5=gentler curve, 1.0=linear scaling, 2.0=steeper curve, 3.0+=very steep adaptation

--mirostat-lr.tooltip:
Mirostat Learning Rate (Eta)
• Function: How quickly Mirostat adapts the probability distribution to maintain target entropy
• Range: 0.01 to 1.0
• Server Default: 0.1
• Effects: 0.01=very slow adaptation, 0.1=balanced, 0.5=moderate speed, 1.0=rapid adaptation

--mirostat-ent.tooltip:
Mirostat Target Entropy (Tau)
• Function: Target entropy level that Mirostat tries to maintain (controls output complexity)
• Range: 1.0 to 10.0
• Server Default: 5.0
• Effects: 2.0=simple/predictable, 5.0=balanced complexity, 8.0=more varied, 10.0=high diversity

--dry-sequence-breaker.tooltip:
DRY Sequence Breaker
• Function: Custom string that breaks DRY pattern detection (clears defaults: \n, :, ", *)
• Range: Any string or "none"
• Server Default: \n, :, ", * (built-in)
• Effects: "none"=no breakers, custom string=only that breaker, useful for specific text patterns
• WARNING: Clears out default breakers when custom string is provided

--logit-bias.recommended: Use sparingly for specific token control
--logit-bias.tooltip:
Logit Bias Control
• Function: Direct manipulation of token probabilities by modifying logits before sampling
• Range: TOKEN_ID(+/-)BIAS format (e.g., 15043+1, 15043-inf)
• Server Default: none
• Effects: +bias=increase probability, -bias=decrease, -inf=ban token, fine-grained control

--samplers.tooltip:
Sampler Sequence Control
• Function: Defines which sampling methods run and their execution order (semicolon-separated)
• Range: penalties;dry;top_n_sigma;top_k;typ_p;top_p;min_p;xtc;temperature
• Server Default: penalties;dry;top_n_sigma;top_k;typ_p;top_p;min_p;xtc;temperature
• Effects: Order matters - early samplers affect later ones, missing samplers are skipped

--sampler-seq.range: Letter sequence (e=penalties, d=dry, s=top_n_sigma, k=top_k, y=typ_p, p=top_p, m=min_p, x=xtc, t=temperature)
--sampler-seq.tooltip:
Simplified Sampler Sequence
• Function: Shorthand letter codes for sampler sequence (alternative to --samplers)
• Range: e=penalties, d=dry, s=top_n_sigma, k=top_k, y=typ_p, p=top_p, m=min_p, x=xtc, t=temperature
• Server Default: edskypmxt
• Effects: Easier to specify common sequences, same order-dependency rules apply

--cont-batching.tooltip:
Continuous Batching (Enable)
• Function: Enables dynamic batching of multiple requests for improved throughput
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: true (enabled)
• Effects: true=better multi-request performance, false=sequential processing
• WARNING: Conflicts with --no-cont-batching - only enable one

--threads-batch.tooltip:
Batch Processing Threads
• Function: Number of CPU threads used during batch and prompt processing operations
• Range: -1 or 1 to 128 (-1 = auto, defaults to same as --threads)
• Server Default: same as --threads
• Effects: -1=auto-detect, manual=specific threading, usually same as generation threads for consistency

--reasoning-format.tooltip:
Reasoning Format Control
• Function: Controls how thought/reasoning tags are processed and returned in responses
• Range: none, deepseek
• Server Default: deepseek
• Effects: none=raw thoughts in content, deepseek=structured reasoning_content field (except streaming), determines thought extraction

--reasoning-budget.tooltip:
Reasoning Token Budget
• Function: Controls maximum amount of thinking/reasoning tokens allowed in responses
• Range: -1, 0, or positive integers
• Server Default: -1 (unlimited)
• Effects: -1=unrestricted thinking, 0=disable thinking entirely, positive=token limit for reasoning

--keep.tooltip:
Initial Prompt Retention
• Function: Number of tokens to keep from the initial prompt when context window fills up
• Range: -1, 0, or positive integers
• Server Default: 0 (keep none)
• Effects: 0=discard prompt when full, -1=keep entire prompt, positive=keep N tokens from start

--no-cont-batching.tooltip:
Continuous Batching (Disable)
• Function: Explicitly disables dynamic batching of requests
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (continuous batching enabled by default)
• Effects: true=sequential processing, false=allows batching
• WARNING: Conflicts with --cont-batching - only enable one

--parallel.ui_widget: Number spinner with warning for high values
--parallel.tooltip:
Parallel Sequence Processing
• Function: Number of independent inference sequences that can be processed simultaneously
• Range: 1 to 64+
• Server Default: 1
• Effects: 1=single sequence, 2-4=moderate parallelism, 8+=high concurrency but exponential memory usage

--defrag-thold.tooltip:
KV Cache Defragmentation
• Function: Threshold for triggering KV cache defragmentation to reclaim fragmented memory
• Range: -1.0 to 1.0 (<0 = disabled)
• Server Default: 0.1
• Effects: <0=disabled, 0.1=balanced, 0.5=aggressive defrag, higher=more frequent defragmentation

--cache-reuse.tooltip:
KV Cache Reuse
• Function: Minimum chunk size to attempt reusing from cache via KV shifting optimization
• Range: 0 to unlimited
• Server Default: 0 (disabled)
• Effects: 0=no reuse, 512-1024=moderate reuse, 2048+=aggressive reuse, can improve performance with repeated patterns

--grammar.tooltip:
BNF Grammar Constraints
• Function: Backus-Naur Form grammar rules that restrict generation to valid syntax patterns
• Range: Valid BNF grammar syntax
• Server Default: empty (no constraints)
• Effects: Ensures structured output, prevents invalid syntax, useful for code/data generation

--grammar-file.tooltip:
Grammar File Path
• Function: Path to file containing BNF grammar rules (alternative to inline --grammar)
• Range: Valid file path to .gbnf or text file
• Server Default: none
• Effects: Loads grammar from file, convenient for complex/reusable grammars, see grammars/ directory

--json-schema.ui_widget: Large text area with JSON validation
--json-schema.tooltip:
JSON Schema Constraints
• Function: JSON Schema specification that enforces valid JSON structure in generation
• Range: Valid JSON Schema syntax (draft-07 compatible)
• Server Default: empty (no constraints)
• Effects: Guarantees valid JSON output, enforces types/properties, useful for API responses

--json-schema-file.tooltip:
JSON Schema File Path
• Function: Path to file containing JSON Schema definition (alternative to inline --json-schema)
• Range: Valid file path to .json schema file
• Server Default: none
• Effects: Loads schema from file, convenient for complex/reusable schemas

--no-webui.tooltip:
Disable Web UI
• Function: Disables the built-in web interface for API-only server operation
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (Web UI enabled)
• Effects: true=API-only mode+better performance, false=web UI available, disable for benchmarking

--metrics.tooltip:
Prometheus Metrics Endpoint
• Function: Enables /metrics endpoint compatible with Prometheus monitoring systems
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (disabled)
• Effects: true=monitoring data available, false=no metrics, useful for performance tracking and alerting

--slots.tooltip:
Slots Monitoring Endpoint
• Function: Enables /slots endpoint for monitoring request processing slots and queue status
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (disabled)
• Effects: true=slot visibility+transparency, false=no slot monitoring, essential for debugging concurrency

--props.tooltip:
Properties Management Endpoint
• Function: Enables /props endpoint for viewing and modifying server properties at runtime
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (disabled)
• Effects: true=runtime configuration changes, false=static config, allows dynamic parameter adjustment

--embedding.tooltip:
Embedding-Only Mode
• Function: Restricts server to only support embedding operations (no text generation)
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (full functionality)
• Effects: true=embedding endpoints only, false=full text generation, use only with dedicated embedding models

--reranking.tooltip:
Document Reranking Endpoint
• Function: Enables /rerank endpoint for document reranking and relevance scoring operations
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (disabled)
• Effects: true=reranking capabilities, false=no reranking, useful for search and retrieval applications

--no-slots.tooltip: Disable slots monitoring endpoint. Conflicts with --slots - only enable one.

--mmproj.tooltip:
Multimodal Projector File
• Function: Path to multimodal projector file for vision/audio processing capabilities
• Range: Valid path to projector file
• Server Default: none
• Effects: Enables multimodal features, can be omitted if using -hf, see tools/mtmd/README.md

--no-mmproj.tooltip:
Disable Multimodal Projector
• Function: Explicitly prevents loading of multimodal projection layers
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (auto-detect and load if available)
• Effects: true=text-only mode, false=auto multimodal support
• WARNING: Useful when using -hf flag and you want text-only operation

--mmproj-url.tooltip:
Multimodal Projector URL
• Function: HTTP/HTTPS URL to download multimodal projector file
• Range: Valid HTTP/HTTPS URL
• Server Default: none
• Effects: Downloads projector for multimodal support, alternative to local file, see tools/mtmd/README.md

--no-mmproj-offload.tooltip:
Disable Multimodal GPU Offload
• Function: Prevents offloading of multimodal projector operations to GPU
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (allow GPU offload)
• Effects: true=projector stays on CPU, false=can use GPU, may reduce GPU memory usage but slower multimodal processing

--hf-repo-v.tooltip: HuggingFace repository for vocoder model in audio generation.

--hf-file-v.tooltip:
HuggingFace Vocoder File
• Function: Specifies exact vocoder model file from HuggingFace repository (for TTS/audio generation)
• Range: Valid GGUF filename
• Server Default: none
• Effects: Selects specific vocoder file, used with audio generation models, alternative to automatic selection

--model-vocoder.tooltip: Path to vocoder model file for audio generation capabilities.

--tts-use-guide-tokens.tooltip:
TTS Guide Tokens
• Function: Enables guide tokens to improve text-to-speech word recall and pronunciation accuracy
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (disabled)
• Effects: true=better TTS accuracy, false=standard TTS, helps with difficult pronunciations and proper nouns

--rope-scaling.tooltip:
RoPE Frequency Scaling Method
• Function: Method for scaling RoPE (Rotary Position Embedding) frequencies to extend context
• Range: none, linear, yarn
• Server Default: linear (unless specified by model)
• Effects: none=no scaling, linear=simple scaling, yarn=advanced YaRN algorithm for better quality

--rope-scale.tooltip:
RoPE Context Scaling Factor
• Function: Factor by which to expand the context window using RoPE scaling
• Range: 0.1 to 10.0 (typically 1.0-8.0)
• Server Default: 1.0 (no scaling)
• Effects: 1.0=original context, 2.0=double context, 4.0=4x context, higher=longer but may degrade quality

--rope-freq-base.tooltip:
RoPE Base Frequency
• Function: Base frequency value used in RoPE calculations for NTK-aware scaling
• Range: 1000 to 100000 (model-dependent)
• Server Default: loaded from model
• Effects: Model-specific value, 10000=common default, affects how position embeddings scale

--rope-freq-scale.tooltip:
RoPE Frequency Scale Factor
• Function: Frequency scaling factor that expands context by factor of 1/N
• Range: 0.1 to 10.0
• Server Default: 1.0 (no scaling)
• Effects: 1.0=original, 0.5=double context, 0.25=4x context, inverse relationship to context expansion

--yarn-orig-ctx.tooltip:
YaRN Original Context Size
• Function: Original context size the model was trained on (for YaRN scaling calculations)
• Range: 0 to 131072 (0 = auto-detect from model)
• Server Default: 0 (model training context size)
• Effects: 0=use model default, manual value=override for YaRN calculations, affects scaling quality

--yarn-ext-factor.tooltip:
YaRN Extrapolation Mix Factor
• Function: Controls the mix between interpolation and extrapolation in YaRN scaling
• Range: -1.0 to 1.0
• Server Default: -1.0 (auto)
• Effects: -1.0=automatic, 0.0=full interpolation, 1.0=full extrapolation, affects context extension quality

--yarn-attn-factor.tooltip:
YaRN Attention Factor
• Function: YaRN attention magnitude scaling factor (scales sqrt(t) in attention calculation)
• Range: 0.1 to 2.0
• Server Default: 1.0
• Effects: 1.0=no scaling, >1.0=amplified attention, <1.0=dampened attention, affects context extension quality

--yarn-beta-slow.tooltip:
YaRN Beta Slow (Alpha)
• Function: YaRN high correction dimension parameter (alpha) for frequency scaling
• Range: 0.1 to 10.0
• Server Default: 1.0
• Effects: Controls high-frequency correction in YaRN algorithm, affects quality of long context extension

--yarn-beta-fast.tooltip:
YaRN Beta Fast (Beta)
• Function: YaRN low correction dimension parameter (beta) for frequency scaling
• Range: 1.0 to 128.0
• Server Default: 32.0
• Effects: Controls low-frequency correction in YaRN algorithm, affects quality of long context extension

--lora.tooltip:
LoRA Adapter File
• Function: Path to LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) adapter file for model fine-tuning
• Range: Valid path to LoRA adapter file
• Server Default: none
• Effects: Applies LoRA modifications to model, can be repeated for multiple adapters, enhances model capabilities

--lora-scaled.tooltip:
Scaled LoRA Adapter
• Function: LoRA adapter with user-defined scaling factor for fine-tuned strength control
• Range: File path and scale factor (e.g., adapter.gguf 0.8)
• Server Default: none
• Effects: Custom scaling allows precise control of LoRA influence, can be repeated for multiple scaled adapters

--control-vector.tooltip:
Control Vector File
• Function: Adds control vector for steering model behavior and outputs
• Range: Valid path to control vector file
• Server Default: none
• Effects: Influences model behavior/style, can be repeated for multiple vectors, provides fine-grained control

--control-vector-scaled.tooltip:
Scaled Control Vector
• Function: Control vector with user-defined scaling factor for precise influence control
• Range: File path and scale factor (e.g., control.gguf 1.2)
• Server Default: none
• Effects: Custom scaling controls vector influence strength, can be repeated for multiple scaled vectors

--control-vector-layer-range.tooltip:
Control Vector Layer Range
• Function: Specifies which model layers to apply control vector(s) to (start and end inclusive)
• Range: START-END format (e.g., 0-10)
• Server Default: all layers
• Effects: Restricts vector application to specific layers, allows targeted model steering, 0-10=first 11 layers

--lora-init-without-apply.tooltip:
LoRA Deferred Application
• Function: Loads LoRA adapters without immediately applying them to the model
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (apply immediately)
• Effects: true=load but don't apply, false=load and apply, allows dynamic application via POST /lora-adapters endpoint

--draft-max.tooltip:
Draft Token Count (Max)
• Function: Maximum number of tokens to draft ahead in speculative decoding for acceleration
• Range: 1 to 64
• Server Default: 16
• Effects: Higher=more speculative tokens+potential speed boost, lower=less speculation, requires draft model

--draft-min.tooltip:
Draft Token Count (Min)
• Function: Minimum number of tokens to draft in speculative decoding
• Range: 0 to 32
• Server Default: 0
• Effects: Sets lower bound for drafting, 0=no minimum, higher=guaranteed minimum speculation level

--draft-p-min.tooltip:
Draft Probability Threshold
• Function: Minimum probability threshold for accepting draft tokens (greedy decoding)
• Range: 0.1 to 1.0
• Server Default: 0.8
• Effects: Higher=more conservative acceptance, lower=more aggressive acceptance, affects speed vs quality trade-off

--model-draft.tooltip:
Draft Model File
• Function: Path to smaller/faster draft model used for speculative decoding acceleration
• Range: Valid path to GGUF model file
• Server Default: unused (no speculative decoding)
• Effects: Required for speculative decoding, should be smaller/faster than main model for speed benefits

--ctx-size-draft.tooltip:
Draft Model Context Size
• Function: Context window size specifically for the draft model
• Range: 0 to 32768+ (0 = load from model metadata)
• Server Default: 0 (loaded from model)
• Effects: 0=use model default, manual value=override draft model context, affects draft quality

--device-draft.tooltip:
Draft Model GPU Devices
• Function: Comma-separated list of GPU devices for draft model offloading
• Range: Device IDs (0,1,2...) or 'none'
• Server Default: none (CPU)
• Effects: Specifies which GPUs to use for draft model, 'none'=CPU only, separate from main model devices

--n-gpu-layers-draft.tooltip:
Draft Model GPU Layers
• Function: Number of draft model layers to offload to GPU VRAM
• Range: 0 to 200 (model-dependent)
• Server Default: 0 (CPU-only)
• Effects: Higher=more GPU utilization for draft model, 0=CPU only, independent of main model layer offloading

--hf-repo-draft.tooltip:
Draft Model HuggingFace Repository
• Function: HuggingFace repository for downloading draft model (same format as --hf-repo)
• Range: <user>/<model>[:quant] format
• Server Default: unused
• Effects: Auto-downloads draft model from HF, alternative to local file, should be smaller/faster than main model

--device.tooltip:
GPU Device Selection
• Function: Comma-separated list of GPU devices to use for model offloading
• Range: Device IDs (0,1,2...) or 'none'
• Server Default: automatic detection
• Effects: Restricts GPU usage to specified devices, 'none'=CPU-only, use --list-devices to see available

--tensor-split.tooltip:
Tensor Split Proportions
• Function: Fraction of model to offload to each GPU in multi-GPU setup
• Range: Comma-separated proportions (e.g., 3,1 = 75%/25%)
• Server Default: equal distribution
• Effects: Controls model distribution across GPUs, proportional to values, 3,1=75%/25%, 2,1,1=50%/25%/25%

--numa.tooltip:
NUMA Optimizations
• Function: NUMA (Non-Uniform Memory Access) system optimizations for multi-socket systems
• Range: distribute, isolate, numactl, or empty
• Server Default: none
• Effects: distribute=spread across nodes, isolate=single node only, numactl=use system CPU map, helps performance on NUMA systems

--cpu-mask.tooltip:
CPU Affinity Mask
• Function: Hexadecimal CPU affinity mask specifying which CPU cores to use
• Range: Arbitrarily long hexadecimal value
• Server Default: empty (no restriction)
• Effects: Restricts CPU usage to specified cores, complements --cpu-range, 0x1=core 0, 0xFF=cores 0-7

--cpu-range.tooltip:
CPU Core Range
• Function: Range of CPU cores for thread affinity (complements --cpu-mask)
• Range: lo-hi format (e.g., 0-7)
• Server Default: no restriction
• Effects: Restricts CPU usage to specified core range, 0-3=first 4 cores, 4-7=next 4 cores

--cpu-strict.tooltip:
Strict CPU Placement
• Function: Enables strict CPU placement for better performance isolation
• Range: true/false (or 0/1)
• Server Default: false (0)
• Effects: true=strict core binding, false=flexible scheduling, improves performance consistency on NUMA systems

--cpu-mask-batch.tooltip: CPU affinity mask for batch processing. Same format as --cpu-mask.

--cpu-range-batch.tooltip: CPU core range for batch processing. Same format as --cpu-range.

--cpu-strict-batch.tooltip: Use strict CPU placement for batch processing.

--poll-batch.tooltip: Use polling for batch work detection. Inherits from --poll setting.

--prio-batch.tooltip:
Batch Process Priority
• Function: Sets process priority specifically for batch operations (same values as --prio)
• Range: -1 to 3 (-1=low, 0=normal, 1=medium, 2=high, 3=realtime)
• Server Default: varies by system
• Effects: Higher=more CPU priority for batch processing, may improve throughput but affect system responsiveness

--mlock.tooltip:
Memory Locking
• Function: Forces system to keep model permanently in RAM, preventing swapping or compression
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (allow swapping)
• Effects: true=guaranteed RAM residency+consistent performance, false=may swap to disk, requires sufficient RAM

--no-mmap.tooltip:
Disable Memory Mapping
• Function: Disables memory-mapped file access, loading model directly into RAM
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (use memory mapping)
• Effects: true=slower load but may reduce pageouts, false=faster load via mmap, useful when not using mlock

--no-kv-offload.tooltip:
Disable KV Cache Offload
• Function: Prevents KV cache from being offloaded to GPU memory
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (allow GPU offload)
• Effects: true=KV cache stays in CPU RAM, false=can use GPU VRAM for cache, may reduce GPU memory usage

--api-key.tooltip:
API Authentication Key
• Function: API key required for client authentication and request authorization
• Range: Any non-empty string
• Server Default: none (no authentication)
• Effects: Enables API security, clients must use Authorization: Bearer <key> header, can use LLAMA_API_KEY env var

--api-key-file.tooltip:
API Key File
• Function: Path to file containing multiple valid API keys (newline-delimited)
• Range: Valid path to readable text file
• Server Default: none
• Effects: Loads multiple API keys from file, any key in file grants access, alternative to single --api-key

--ssl-key-file.range: Path to SSL private key file
--ssl-key-file.tooltip:
SSL Private Key File
• Function: Path to PEM-encoded SSL private key file for HTTPS encryption
• Range: Valid path to .pem/.key file
• Server Default: none (HTTP only)
• Effects: Enables HTTPS, requires matching SSL certificate, secures all communications

--ssl-cert-file.tooltip:
SSL Certificate File
• Function: Path to PEM-encoded SSL certificate file for HTTPS encryption
• Range: Valid path to .pem/.crt file
• Server Default: none (HTTP only)
• Effects: Enables HTTPS, requires matching SSL private key, validates server identity

--log-disable.tooltip:
Disable Logging
• Function: Completely disables all logging output for maximum performance
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (logging enabled)
• Effects: true=no logs+minimal overhead, false=normal logging, useful for production performance

--log-file.tooltip:
Log File Output
• Function: Redirects log output to specified file instead of stdout/stderr
• Range: Valid writable file path
• Server Default: stdout/stderr
• Effects: Enables persistent logging, file rotation not included, useful for debugging and monitoring

--verbose.tooltip:
Verbose Logging (Debug)
• Function: Sets verbosity level to infinity (logs all messages useful for debugging)
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (normal verbosity)
• Effects: true=maximum debug output, false=normal logging, useful for troubleshooting issues

--log-colors.tooltip:
Colored Log Output
• Function: Enables colored log output for improved readability and message categorization
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (no colors)
• Effects: true=colored logs, false=plain text, can use LLAMA_LOG_COLORS env var, improves debugging experience

--log-timestamps.tooltip:
Log Timestamps
• Function: Includes timestamps in all log messages for temporal tracking
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (no timestamps)
• Effects: true=timestamped logs, false=no timestamps, can use LLAMA_LOG_TIMESTAMPS env var, essential for debugging timing issues

--log-verbosity.tooltip:
Log Verbosity Level
• Function: Sets verbosity threshold - messages with higher verbosity are ignored
• Range: 0 to 5 (0=errors only, 5=all messages)
• Server Default: varies
• Effects: Lower=fewer messages, higher=more debug info, can use LLAMA_LOG_VERBOSITY env var

--log-prefix.tooltip: Enable prefix in log messages for better categorization.

--verbose-prompt.tooltip: Print verbose prompt before generation for debugging.

--list-devices.tooltip: Print list of available devices and exit. Utility function.

--check-tensors.tooltip: Check model tensor data for invalid values during loading.

--no-context-shift.tooltip:
Disable Context Shifting
• Function: Disables context shift mechanism during infinite text generation
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (context shift enabled)
• Effects: true=no context management, false=automatic context shifting, may cause memory issues with very long generations

--special.tooltip:
Special Tokens Output
• Function: Enables output of special tokens (BOS, EOS, etc.) for debugging and analysis
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (hidden special tokens)
• Effects: true=visible special tokens, false=hidden tokens, useful for debugging tokenization issues

--no-warmup.tooltip:
Skip Model Warmup
• Function: Skips the initial model warmup run that prepares the model for inference
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (perform warmup)
• Effects: true=faster startup but cold first inference, false=warmed up model ready for optimal performance

--spm-infill.tooltip:
SPM Infill Pattern
• Function: Uses Suffix/Prefix/Middle pattern instead of Prefix/Suffix/Middle for fill-in-middle tasks
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (PSM pattern)
• Effects: true=SPM pattern, false=PSM pattern, some models prefer SPM ordering for better infill quality

--pooling.range: none, mean, cls, last, rank, or empty
--pooling.tooltip:
Embedding Pooling Method
• Function: Pooling strategy for combining token embeddings into sentence/document embeddings
• Range: none, mean, cls, last, rank, or empty
• Server Default: model default (if unspecified)
• Effects: mean=average pooling, cls=CLS token, last=last token, none/rank=specialized, empty=model decides

--jinja.tooltip:
Enable Custom Jinja Templates
• Function: Allows custom Jinja chat templates beyond built-in ones
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (built-in only)
• Effects: true=accept any Jinja syntax in --chat-template, false=only built-in templates like chatml/llama3
• Usage: Enable this flag before using custom Jinja templates in --chat-template or --chat-template-file

--chat-template.tooltip:
Custom Chat Template
• Function: Sets custom Jinja chat template that overrides model's built-in conversation formatting
• Range: Jinja template string or built-in template names
• Server Default: template from model metadata
• Effects: Controls conversation formatting, built-in names: chatml, llama3, deepseek, etc., or custom Jinja syntax
• WARNING: If suffix/prefix specified, template will be disabled, only common templates accepted unless --jinja set

--chat-template-file.tooltip:
Chat Template File
• Function: Loads custom Jinja chat template from file (alternative to inline --chat-template)
• Range: Valid path to template file
• Server Default: model metadata template
• Effects: Overrides model template, useful for complex templates, see --chat-template for format details

--chat-template-kwargs.tooltip:
Chat Template Arguments (CLI Flag)
• Function: Pass template parameters to server via command line argument
• Format: JSON string for --chat-template-kwargs flag
• Primary Use: GPT-OSS models and custom Jinja templates
• Examples:
  - {"reasoning_effort": "low"} - minimal thinking
  - {"reasoning_effort": "medium"} - balanced reasoning (default)
  - {"reasoning_effort": "high"} - maximum reasoning depth
• Usage: Enter JSON string that gets passed as CLI argument
• Technical: Equivalent to --chat-template-kwargs '{"key": "value"}' in command line

--no-prefill-assistant.tooltip:
Disable Assistant Prefill
• Function: Disables prefilling of assistant response when last message is from assistant
• Range: true/false
• Server Default: false (prefill enabled)
• Effects: true=treat assistant messages as complete, false=prefill assistant responses, affects conversation flow

--slot-prompt-similarity.tooltip:
Slot Prompt Similarity
• Function: Similarity threshold for reusing existing processing slots with matching prompts
• Range: 0.0 to 1.0 (0.0 = disabled, 1.0 = exact match)
• Server Default: 0.5
• Effects: Higher=stricter matching, lower=more reuse, 0.0=no reuse, optimization for repeated similar prompts

--slot-save-path.tooltip:
Slot Save Directory
• Function: Directory path for saving slot KV cache data for persistence across restarts
• Range: Valid writable directory path
• Server Default: disabled (no saving)
• Effects: Enables slot persistence, faster warmup for repeated sessions, requires sufficient disk space

--path.tooltip:
Static Files Path
• Function: Directory path for serving static files through the built-in web server
• Range: Valid readable directory path
• Server Default: empty (no static files)
• Effects: Enables serving HTML/CSS/JS files, useful for custom web interfaces, complements API endpoints

--override-tensor.tooltip: Override tensor buffer types. Format: pattern=type,pattern=type.

--override-kv.tooltip:
Override Model Metadata
• Function: Advanced option to override specific model metadata values by key
• Range: KEY=TYPE:VALUE format (types: int, float, bool, str)
• Server Default: use model metadata as-is
• Effects: Can modify tokenizer settings, model behavior, use carefully as it can break model functionality

--no-perf.tooltip: Disable internal libllama performance timings for minimal overhead.

--escape.tooltip: Process escape sequences like \n, \r, \t in input text.

--no-escape.tooltip: Disable escape sequence processing. Conflicts with --escape.

--prio.tooltip:
Process Priority
• Function: Sets overall process priority for the llama server
• Range: -1 to 3 (-1=low, 0=normal, 1=medium, 2=high, 3=realtime)
• Server Default: 0 (normal)
• Effects: Higher=more CPU scheduling priority, 3=realtime can affect system stability, use carefully

--poll.tooltip: Polling level for work detection. 0=no polling, higher=more responsive.
